programs.title: Desi Veg Ka Dhamaka
programs.desc: Indian desi veg recipes are renowned for their vibrant spices, diverse flavors, and reliance on lentils, legumes, vegetables, and dairy (paneer) to create wholesome, nutritious meals. They offer a balance of protein, fiber, and carbohydrates, often featuring tempering (tadka) techniques to enhance aroma and flavor.
